description: This file implements functions related to launching and managing text editors within a Git environment, including selecting the appropriate editor based on environment variables, launching editors, and editing buffers interactively.

methods.name: int is_terminal_dumb(void)
methods.description: Checks whether the terminal is a 'dumb' terminal by inspecting the TERM environment variable.

methods.name: const char * git_editor(void)
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate editor command based on environment variables and default settings.

methods.name: const char * git_sequence_editor(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence editor setting, falling back to git_editor if not explicitly set.

methods.name: int launch_specified_editor(const char * editor,const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches a specified editor for a given file path, handling terminal compatibility and capturing output.

methods.name: int launch_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the default git editor for the specified file and reads the edited content into a buffer.

methods.name: int launch_sequence_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor for editing a file, reading back the result.

methods.name: int strbuf_edit_interactively(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * path,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Allows interactive editing of a buffer's content by writing to a file, invoking a text editor, and reading the result back into the buffer.
